title_zh: 自助網上正念減壓訓練對癌症患者困擾的成效（Reduct）：多中心隨機對照試驗
title_en: Reduct RCT: online mindfulness training for distress in cancer patients
summary_zh: 德國 8 間大學醫院招募 561 名新確診或復發癌症患者，隨機分派至 16 週自助網上介入或優化常規治療。主要結果 HADS 總分組間差異不顯著，但焦慮症狀與自我效能有顯著改善。作者建議作階梯式照護中的輔助選項。
summary_en: In the Reduct multicentre RCT (n=561), 16 weeks of self-guided web-based mindfulness and skills-based distress reduction training did not significantly reduce overall distress (HADS total) versus optimised treatment as usual in cancer patients, but anxiety symptoms and self-efficacy improved significantly. The authors suggest it as an adjunct within stepped care.
caution: 主要結果為陰性（HADS 總分差異不顯著）；焦慮與自我效能的改善屬次要結果，需謹慎解讀。
brief_zh: 561 名癌症患者，16 週自助網上介入對比優化常規治療
主要結果 HADS 總分差異不顯著
焦慮症狀與自我效能有顯著改善
supervision_questions: 主要結果陰性但次要結果有改善時，你如何向個案解釋這個介入的期望值？

posts.title: Self-guided web-based mindfulness and skills-based distress reduction training versus treatment as usual optimised in patients with cancer (Reduct): a multicentre, parallel-group, randomised controlled trial
posts.content: 德國多中心隨機對照試驗，比較 16 週自助網上正念減壓訓練與優化常規治療對癌症患者困擾的成效。
